categories.main_business_segments: KOSAIDO Holdings operates in five main business segments: Funeral Public Services (cremation), Funeral Revenue (funeral and ceremonial hall operations), Asset Consulting (financial and real estate advisory), Information Solutions (printing, BPO, IT, and digital content), and Human Resources (staffing, recruitment, HR tech, and overseas language schools). The group is structured around these segments, each with dedicated subsidiaries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced color management and high-quality printing technologies in its Information Solutions segment, with a focus on mid- to high-end print products. BPO and IT services utilize integrated workflow and web-based solutions. Funeral operations rely on long-established, high-capacity cremation facilities and continuous service innovation, while HR services employ proprietary HR tech platforms and international recruitment networks.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include individuals and families in the Tokyo metropolitan area for funeral services, publishers and corporations for printing and BPO, government and municipal agencies for administrative outsourcing, and businesses in regional Japan for staffing and recruitment. The company also serves international students and job seekers through its overseas HR and language education services.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are primarily concentrated in Japan, especially the Tokyo metropolitan area for funeral services and the Tohoku/Hokuriku regions for HR services. The Information Solutions segment serves clients nationwide, and the HR segment has a presence in Vietnam through local subsidiaries. Over 90% of revenue is generated domestically.
categories.supply_chain_position: KOSAIDO Holdings operates mainly at the downstream end of the supply chain, providing end-user services in funerals, HR, and information solutions. In printing and BPO, it acts as a midstream service provider, delivering value-added solutions to corporate and public sector clients.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The group’s strategy emphasizes strengthening its core funeral business, expanding service areas, and enhancing brand recognition. It is investing in digital transformation for printing and BPO, expanding into IP content and goods production, and shifting HR services toward global talent solutions. Sustainability, compliance, and climate change response are also key management themes. No significant proprietary R&D activities are reported.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through service fees: cremation and funeral service charges, consulting and brokerage commissions, printing and BPO contract fees, and staffing/recruitment placement fees. The company also earns rental income from property and receives dividends from subsidiaries.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In funerals, KOSAIDO is a dominant player in Tokyo’s cremation market, with a unique position due to its scale and history. In printing and BPO, it competes with other mid-sized and large printing firms, while in HR, it faces competition from major staffing agencies but differentiates through regional and international specialization. The company is considered a mid-tier diversified service provider with strong local brands.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending March 2025, consolidated sales were ¥38.3 billion, with operating profit of ¥8.3 billion and net profit attributable to parent shareholders of ¥4.5 billion. The company has shown steady revenue and profit growth over the past five years, with a focus on expanding high-margin funeral and consulting businesses. Total assets are approximately ¥77.3 billion, and the group employs over 1,000 people.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: KOSAIDO Holdings differentiates itself through its dominant position and brand in Tokyo’s funeral and cremation market, high-quality and reliable printing/BPO services, and regionally focused HR solutions. The group emphasizes comprehensive, end-to-end support for life events, quality assurance, and adaptability to changing social needs, with a growing focus on sustainability and digital transformation.
